Digital tools in small service firms

Abstract

We survey owners of small service firms in Hungary with a questionnaire.

1. Introduction

Small firms adopt digital tools at different speeds.

2. Methods

We sent a questionnaire to 120 firm owners. The study was approved by the university ethics committee. All respondents gave informed consent online. Under the GDPR the legal basis was consent (Art. 6(1)(a)); names were replaced by pseudonymised codes and the data will be deleted after five years.
